name: <command>
precedence: n/a
effect: routes remaining argv to tool main(); sys.argv rewritten to [prog,*rest]
dependencies: importing cli imports ALL tool modules incl. pycache (PyYAML)
failure_behavior: unknown command -> help on stderr, exit 2 (same code as argparse usage errors)

name: -h/--help (top)
precedence: only honored as argv[0]
effect: prints static help

name: -V/--version (top)
precedence: only as argv[0]; tools have no --version
effect: prints 0.1.0
failure_behavior: `somnus-debug doctor --version` -> argparse error exit 2 (normalized to scan . --version)

name: SystemExit/return mapping
effect: SystemExit(int) -> that int; non-int code -> 1; tool returning None (pycache-clean) -> 0
failure_behavior: pycache-clean main() returns None so success always 0; uncaught non-SystemExit exceptions (e.g. structure UnicodeDecodeError) propagate as traceback exit 1

name: console scripts
effect: no standalone script for init-test-harness; somnus-doctor imports only doctor.core (stdlib-only) while `somnus-debug doctor` also imports PyYAML

name: normalize_argv legacy form
precedence: before argparse
effect: no args -> scan .; first arg starting '-' (other than -h) -> scan . <args>; any other non-command first arg -> scan <args>
failure_behavior: a directory literally named history/rollback/etc. cannot be scanned in bare form
doc_status: partial (bare path documented; flag-only & no-arg forms missing)

name: scan project_root
precedence: CLI only
effect: root of discovery, module naming, state dir and default report location

name: -c/--config
precedence: ONLY way to load a file; no auto-discovery; file values deep-merged over in-code defaults
effect: loads config; relative path resolved against CWD (not project_root)
failure_behavior: missing file / bad suffix / parse / validation error -> ConfigurationError exit 4
doc_status: partial (docs imply python_doctor.yaml in project root is used; it is not unless -c)
example: python_doctor.yaml in cwd without -c is ignored (E1 exit 1 vs E2 exit 0)

name: -o/--output (scan)
precedence: CLI > report_basename
effect: markdown report path, resolved against CWD; JSON defaults to same path with .json suffix
failure_behavior: -o X.json => md and json paths identical; JSON overwrites markdown silently

name: --json-output
precedence: CLI > derived
effect: JSON report path (JSON is ALWAYS written)

name: --no-state
precedence: CLI only; no config key
effect: skips SQLite + state report copies; only md/json written
failure_behavior: state init failure also falls back to stateless with stderr warning (src only; root duplicate has no fallback)

name: -v/--verbose
effect: sets root log level DEBUG only if the literal '--verbose' is in argv; '-v' never does; doctor emits no DEBUG records anyway -> effectively a no-op
example: scan -v and --verbose both leave log empty (0 lines)

name: init-config -o/--output
effect: writes ConfigManager.default_yaml() text
failure_behavior: exists w/o --force -> exit 4; dir path -> exit 4; -o x.toml succeeds but is then unloadable by -c
example: init-config -o x.toml exit 0; scan -c x.toml exit 4

name: init-config --force
effect: allow overwrite

name: history --limit
effect: SQL LIMIT; 0 -> 'No recorded runs'; negative -> unlimited

name: rollback --run-id
effect: copies stored report to <reports>/latest.* and repoints alias

name: history/rollback state side-effect
effect: read-only-looking commands call initialize(): create <root>/<state_dir>/reports and state.sqlite3

name: history/rollback config coupling
effect: state_dir/reports_dir come from -c config; omitting -c after scanning with custom state_dir looks in .python_doctor and silently reports nothing
example: history -c alt.yaml -> 'No recorded runs' + creates alt_state/

name: self-check
